children: The Finance Ministry on Saturday clarified that there was no illegality in the approval process for the stake sale in IDBI Bank.

“The legislative history of the IDBI (Repeal) Act, 2003, the judicial pronouncement of the Delhi High Court and successive Union Budget Speeches collectively demonstrate the evolution of the Government’s policy towards the strategic disinvestment of IDBI Bank,” the Ministry said in a statement. On Wednesday, the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved 10955230 Canada Inc. as the Strategic Buyer for this Transaction for a purchase consideration of over Rs 52800 crore for the acquisition of a 60.72 per cent stake in IDBI Bank Ltd, comprising 30.48 per cent equity shareholding held by the GoI and 30.24 per cent equity shareholding held by the LIC.

title: IDBI Bank stake sale: FinMin cites High Court ruling, Budget speeches to reject irregularity claims
